abilities.name: Flurry
abilities.description: After making a light unarmed attack, as an extra action on your turn you make another light unarmed attack against the same target or a different one. Action. At tier 3: You can make a third light unarmed attack as a third action on your turn. A few character abilities allow you to treat your unarmed attack as a medium weapon instead of a light weapon. You can’t use Flurry with a medium unarmed attack.

abilities.name: Nimble
abilities.description: As a First action, you move up to a short distance and then can take another First action, such as attacking with a light weapon or opening a door (the movement happens before the First action, not the other way around). Unlike a normal situation of taking an action and moving a short distance, this movement doesn’t hinder your tasks.

abilities.name: No Need for Weapons
abilities.description: Your unarmed attacks (such as punches, kicks, elbows, or knees) inflict an additional 2 damage.
